body: FORMAL REVIEW — APPROVE cand-57QNM77A1BJ92Z2F8ENFXNV8CC exact 5dc1f2b6a5e6d4a32e648dd20d40d2e137c2b833 over parent 46f00916f6f2c1dd2a7761e3c4bb5c809a265963. Exact population is the two policy paths; diff/check clean. I read the four former case classes, every AlignWire checked constructor, all use sites, and the external probe. In an isolated no-hardlinks clone with private caches and pinned grakern, clean StructuralChannelUnforgeableSuite passes 4/4. Independent mutation: change StructuralMemberExclusion back to a case class; after clean rebuild the Mirror.ProductOf and companion fromProduct courts both fail, 2/4, so the intended seal is discriminating and the stale incremental trap is avoided. Restored tree is byte-clean. Exact clean compileAll passes JVM/Scala.js/Native across the repository; scalafmtCheckAll and scalafmtSbtCheck pass. I did not independently run testAll. Non-gating debt: the suite-level Scaladoc still says the probes pin a known-bad/open state and are meant to be flipped later, which is now historical rather than current; correct that prose in a follow-up, but it does not weaken the executing court or sealed API. Chief authorization remains separate.
